title: Structured data, paths, and collection transforms

evidence.claimBoundary: This manifest specifies JSON and collection learning probes; no parser, path evaluator, or learned transform is claimed to be available from the manifest alone.

objective: Acquire bounded, composable procedures for JSON parsing, strict and optional paths, collection transforms, and error-sensitive aggregation while preserving null-versus-missing semantics.

included: bounded JSON parse and deterministic stringify
dot and bracket path traversal over objects and arrays
strict access, optional access, and explicit missing values
map, filter, reduce, find, grouping, sorting, and aggregation

teacherSuppliedFields: pure procedure bodies and contract checks

requiredNativeOperations.name: json.parse_bounded
requiredNativeOperations.role: Parse JSON under depth, byte, and item budgets.

requiredNativeOperations.name: json.stringify_canonical
requiredNativeOperations.role: Serialize JSON deterministically for round-trip and comparison checks.

requiredNativeOperations.name: json.path_get_strict
requiredNativeOperations.role: Traverse dot and bracket paths while distinguishing missing from present null.

requiredNativeOperations.name: json.path_get_optional
requiredNativeOperations.role: Return null only for an absent path while preserving malformed-path errors.

requiredNativeOperations.name: collections.map_filter_reduce
requiredNativeOperations.role: Execute bounded collection transforms with item budgets.

requiredNativeOperations.name: collections.group_sort_aggregate
requiredNativeOperations.role: Compose grouping, stable sorting, and aggregation under explicit comparison rules.

requiredCapabilities.name: structured-data.synthetic-fixtures
requiredCapabilities.purpose: Supply generated JSON values and schemas without importing private payloads.

demonstrations.purpose: Establish bounded parse/stringify round-trip behavior and value-type distinctions.

taskModel.inputShape: synthetic JSON objects and arrays containing nested scalars, nulls, and empty collections
taskModel.operation: parse, inspect, and canonical-stringify without changing value meaning

expectedBehavior: Respect depth and size budgets.
Preserve null and collection types.
Produce deterministic serialization.

assertions: Canonical round-trip preserves the parsed value.

demonstrations.purpose: Teach extraction followed by filtering, mapping, and reduction over nested records.

taskModel.inputShape: an array of synthetic records with nested object fields, optional fields, and numeric or text collection members
taskModel.operation: traverse a declared path, apply a bounded collection transform, and return a typed result

expectedBehavior: Keep path semantics explicit.
Compose transforms without mutating input.
Retain a contract for item and output types.

assertions: The transform matches an independently computed result.

counterexamples.purpose: Prevent a path procedure from collapsing missing fields and present null values.

taskModel.inputShape: parallel records where one nested field is absent and another is present with null
taskModel.operation: run strict and optional access and classify the two outcomes

expectedBehavior: Strict access reports absence distinctly.
Optional access returns null only for absence.
Present null remains a value rather than an error.

assertions: Missing and null remain distinguishable in the trace.
Malformed paths are not converted to null.

counterexamples.failureSignal: The procedure treats every failed path lookup as a present null.

counterexamples.purpose: Reject transforms that mutate source collections or rely on unstable ordering.

taskModel.inputShape: a collection reused by two downstream transforms, with equal sort keys and nested records
taskModel.operation: run independent transforms and compare source fingerprint, output order, and aggregation

expectedBehavior: Inputs are immutable.
Tie ordering is explicit and deterministic.
Each transform can be replayed independently.

assertions: Repeated execution has the same result and trace.

counterexamples.failureSignal: A sort, grouping, or reduction changes shared input state or depends on incidental map order.

exercises.purpose: Compose strict path extraction with filtering and reduction on a new synthetic record shape.

taskModel.inputShape: a held-out nested record schema with a collection path, a predicate field, and a numeric aggregation field
taskModel.operation: extract, filter, map, and reduce using reusable procedures and explicit contracts

expectedBehavior: Resolve each dependency by semantic contract.
Report missing or malformed paths according to policy.
Compose without a special-case answer.

assertions: Intermediate values and failures are traceable.

exercises.purpose: Learn grouping and stable comparison as reusable structure rather than one aggregate recipe.

taskModel.inputShape: a collection of records with a grouping key, nullable members, and repeated comparison keys
taskModel.operation: group, sort with declared tie policy, and aggregate while preserving null semantics

expectedBehavior: Use explicit grouping and tie rules.
Do not infer missing values from nulls.
Return a deterministic shape suitable for a second transform.

assertions: Group membership is complete and non-duplicated.
Repeated runs preserve order and totals.

heldOutGeneralization.purpose: Test path and collection composition on a schema family absent from acquisition.

taskModel.inputShape: an unseen nested JSON schema with a new path spelling mix and a collection transform composition
taskModel.operation: parse, traverse, transform, and stringify without Teacher assistance

expectedBehavior: Reuse path and collection semantics compositionally.
Honor budgets and immutable inputs.
Keep Teacher disabled for the whole probe.

assertions: Independent transform and stringify checks pass.

heldOutGeneralization.purpose: Test missing, null, malformed path, and budget boundaries on unseen data without collapsing errors.

taskModel.inputShape: an unseen JSON value containing absent fields, present nulls, malformed path segments, and a bounded-size edge
taskModel.operation: select strict or optional access by contract and fail closed on malformed or over-budget input

expectedBehavior: Preserve the error taxonomy.
Never turn malformed input into a plausible aggregate.
Return inspectable failure evidence under Teacher OFF.

assertions: Malformed and over-budget cases are rejected deterministically.

semanticProperties: strict and optional access have different contracts
bounded JSON parse and canonical stringify
expectedLearnedStructures.compositionRole: Builds reusable data traversal and transform steps.
Prevents plausible but semantically invalid data workflows.

semanticProperties: aggregation has explicit comparison and null policy
expectedLearnedStructures.compositionRole: Allows procedures to be reused in new compositions.
Guards against shortcut transforms and silent coercion.

passCriteria: Known JSON and path transforms execute without Teacher.
Null, missing, and malformed paths remain distinct.

requires: path and collection procedures are available
passCriteria: Extraction, filtering, mapping, grouping, and reduction compose.
Unseen schemas are handled without answer lookup.
Error-sensitive access works on unseen values.
Budget and immutability checks still hold.
All held-out transforms pass with Teacher OFF.
No source payload, path, or authority is transferred.

deny: API keys, cookies, and bearer tokens
redactions: replace records with generated shape descriptors
omit host-specific file roots and environment values

notes: All data examples are shapes and policies rather than payload dumps.
The curriculum deliberately tests missing-versus-null and malformed-path boundaries because successful happy paths alone do not establish learned structure.
